       Summer Uniform (Vodka, Scarlet)
Now then... allow me to introduce myself once more.

I am Aston Machan.
...Nice to meet you.

Oh, is that so?!
Well, I'm sure you'll be getting tons of scout offers after that race!

Mysterious, fond of being photographed, and an absolute star runner on the track.
That was my first impression of Aston Machan.

I want to aim for Umamusume of the Year with you!
I'll make you the strongest racer of your generation!

Not just a mascot.
A globe-trotting super mascot.

............
...Understood. See you around~!

Did you see? I was actually trying pretty hard back there.
...Oh, this is the Machan doll. "~"

And with that, she offered a shy smile.
My reflection danced gently in her round, buoyant eyes.

It's Aston Machan! Catching the leader with her unique high-pitch stride,
Aston Machan edges ahead by half a length—and crosses the finish line!

You've got more than enough already!
Besides, why do you gotta record yourself singing of all things?!
...Hmph!

Yes, that is why.
So, see you later~.

Following my colleague's gaze, amidst the tense atmosphere,
stood a girl entering the gate with a serene smile on her face.

The TV crew really is here! The runners must be super pumped
...Wait, looks more like they're nervous, actually.

After Aston Machan said her piece and walked off,
only bewildered adults were left standing in her wake.

...Um, that's a lovely doll!
By the way, have you already decided on a trainer?

Yes, I'd like you to film me singing in the central plaza.
I completely and utterly forgot my tripod, you see.

Yay.
Here, use this smartphone.
Hmm-hmm, hmm-hmm~... Hm.
That is the grave issue at hand. None have appeared.

I knew it! All right, make sure to get a good shot.
We'll capture the exact moment a contract is formed...!

While her unique high-pitch stride showed undeniable talent,
it was her enigmatic presence that left an even deeper impression.

W-Wait a second! Of course I want
to support your dreams too! Tell me what they are!

............Huh?
Oh, well to win a GⅠ with you, of course!

A-Aston Machan?! ...Ms. Machan! We're from
"New Paka"! That was a spectacular race!

Aston Machan! Please, let me train you!
I'll design plenty of training routines tailored to your legs!

P-Please consider me as well!
I won't let your natural talent go to waste—I'll bring out its full potential!

It's time for the rookie Umamusume discovery special, "New Paka"! Broadcasting today from Tracen Academy,
we're bringing wonderful new talent straight to everyone's living rooms across the nation!
...A m-mascot?

Sorry to cut in suddenly, but could you do it?
This girl, she just... really loves this sort of thing.
...What are your dreams, everyone?

As if drawn in by those words,
a crowd of trainers surrounded Aston Machan.

Is Aston Machan the only calm one here?
Talk about having nerves of steel.

Now then, how will the promising newcomer Aston Machan
respond to this massive crowd of trainers?!

*Pant*, *pant*... Whew.
Ehehe, peace sign.

One day, I was watching a mock race with a colleague
to scout for a trainee. The stands were unusually abuzz. The reason being—
The story goes back a few days—
(Wooooo...!)

She gets so stubborn once she's like this...
Oh well. Let's just film it quickly and head back.

Appearing everywhere, held in the hands of everyone—
that kind of super, no, ultra super mascot is what I want to be!
Machan's dream is to become a mascot.
The more videos there are, the better.
I realized that I hadn't filmed anything yet, you see.
Ah, geez. She's not listening to a word right now.

All right, let's head over the moment they come off the track!
First up, our first-place finisher, Aston Machan—

—And now, we enter the final stretch of the race!
Who will make the first move?!

Um, so then...
I'd like you to film from around here toward over there, sort of like this.
On the way back from the mock race where that happened—
...It's Aston Machan. Nice to meet you.

Excuse me.
Could you hold the camera for me~?

Whoa, wait up, I never agreed to this!
Singing "Umapyoi Densetsu" in a place like this makes no sense!
